sections.overview: In Canada, P. spinicornis is documented as an introduced species.
sections.identification: A dark stripe with yellow mottling distinguishes it from the randomly mottled P. scaber; it reaches about 12 mm.
sections.habitat: It favours dry, exposed limestone and old lime-mortared walls.
sections.behavior: It is often found active on walls at night.
sections.ecology: Its calcareous-wall preference contrasts with the broader habitat range of P. scaber.
sections.conservation: The British group records it widely in Britain and Ireland and lists it as Least Concern there.
